title: Warm Places
description: A dreamy 2-step UK garage slow-burn: felt-piano chords drift in over a soft LinnDrum breakbeat, ghost hats and a warm sub bass gather underneath, then the groove blooms into a swung, emotional peak before settling back to a hazy outro.
